name: UX Agent V2.1 — Orchestra

agents.ux-agent: Orchestrator — phase manager, pipeline controller, 3-phase execution with refinement loops
agents.ux-strategist: Design Thinking, UX research methods (Discover/Explore/Test/Listen), personas, journeys, service blueprints (People/Props/Processes), IA, UX metrics, content quality dimensions
agents.ux-visual: Visual design with Hallmark 6 disciplines, 20 named themes, 54-system reference library, industry aesthetics, DESIGN.md integration, anti-slop enforcement
agents.ux-interaction: Gesture library (mobile/desktop/keyboard), spring physics, loading patterns, feedback systems, FLIP technique, reduced-motion strategy, animation performance
agents.ux-writer: Flesch-Kincaid readability, find→act gap detection, content freshness, voice/tone spectrum, error message formula, banned AI copy catalog, WCAG accessibility in writing
agents.ux-design-system: DTCG 3-tier token architecture, Google DESIGN.md spec (9 sections), 6-gate component quality, 8 interactive states, fidelity ladder L1–L5, design review rubric, Tailwind/DTCG export, multi-framework output (React+Tailwind v4, Next.js 15, SwiftUI 6)
agents.ux-quality: Nielsen 10 heuristics, Norman 7 principles, Shneiderman 8 golden rules, Gestalt 5 laws, WCAG 2.2 AA PRCOA framework, animation performance audit, content quality audit, anti-slop checklist, service design audit, weighted scoring

standards: Gestalt Laws (5: Proximity, Similarity, Continuity, Closure, Figure-Ground)
WCAG 2.2 AA (PRCOA: Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust)
Design Thinking (Empathize → Define → Ideate → Prototype → Test)
Hallmark Design System (6 disciplines, 20 themes, anti-slop gates)
UX Research Method Selection (Discover → Explore → Test → Listen)
